notes.sowing: Sow directly after your last frost, {cm:1} to {cm:2} deep, as the seed needs darkness to germinate. Plants dislike root disturbance, so start any indoors in individual pots only 3 to 4 weeks ahead.
notes.care: Poor to average, well-drained soil gives the most flowers; rich soil gives mostly leaves. Tolerates part shade. Check leaf undersides for cabbage white butterfly eggs and for blackfly, and pinch out badly infested tips. Climbing and trailing types need a support or room to sprawl.
notes.harvest: Flowers start about 8 weeks from sowing and continue until frost. The leaves, flowers, young buds and green seeds are edible; leaves can be picked at any time.
